title: Rooftop run
subtitle: Mind the gaps and the water tanks.

sections.name: Street
sections.note: The street under the terraces: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstRoofs
sections.note: Up the ladder onto the roofs, a run along them, and off the end.

sections.name: FirstGap
sections.note: Two rows with a 1.2 m gap between: jump it. A feather above the gap.

sections.name: FirstTank
sections.note: A water tank on the roofs: jump it. Down, and a vendor's hen in the street.

sections.name: Neem
sections.note: A roadside neem's low limb across the street: slide under. A feather above it.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: LongRun
sections.note: The long run: five houses and two tanks, a gap, three more houses.

sections.name: GoatBasket
sections.note: A goat kid crossing, then the hens' basket.

sections.name: GapTanks
sections.note: Three rows, two gaps, a tank on the first two.

sections.name: ShopSacks
sections.note: Sacks of paddy unloaded at the roadside for a shop: hop on and off. A dog asleep.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: RoofTrain
sections.note: Four rows in a train: jump, jump, jump; a feather above the tank.

sections.name: DungHens
sections.note: Cow dung, then two hens pecking in the street.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: The hand-pump puddle; the rooster knocks the hens' basket into the street; a goat kid.

sections.name: LongTanks
sections.note: The long run again: three tanks and a gap, then down.

sections.name: SandDogBasket
sections.note: A house going up (its sand heap), the dog, the hens' basket.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastRoofs
sections.note: The last long run: two tanks, a gap, a tank, a gap; down.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: The hens' basket, a goat kid, cow dung: the last test.

sections.name: OpenStreet
sections.note: The street opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 300 m.
